_comment: Plugins this repository holds but does not offer in the catalogue. Committed, reviewed and validated like any other plugin — simply not listed, because installing them is not what they are for. Removing an entry here publishes the plugin on the next build; see .github/scripts/build-feeds.mjs.

entries.reason: Scaffolding to copy, not a plugin to install — it calls example.com and does nothing for a user who installs it.
